fields.name: Berobenatide / PF-3944 / PF-08653944 / MET-097i
fields.stage: Phase 3 VESPER-4 and VESPER-6 initiated; VESPER-6 recruiting
fields.summary: Pfizer's 3 February update reports VESPER-4 initiation. Pfizer's later participant page describes the once-monthly VESPER-6 study, and the sponsor-submitted registry record names the medicine berobenatide (PF-08653944), lists the study as recruiting and records an actual 10 June 2026 start.
fields.limitations: These are programme and recruitment updates, not results, UK marketing authorisation, NHS access or evidence of retail supply. VESPER-6 has an estimated May 2028 primary completion date; weekly and monthly regimens remain distinct.

additionalEvidence.title: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT07595549 (VESPER-6)
additionalEvidence.checkScope: Sponsor-submitted registry record read for the adopted name, recruitment status and actual start date; not automatically content-monitored.

sources.title: Pfizer VESPER-6 participant information
sources.evidenceType: Original sponsor trial-participant information; not regulatory approval
sources.assessment: The complete Pfizer page describes VESPER-6 as a once-monthly, 72-week injectable GLP-1 receptor agonist study for adults with overweight or obesity. It does not establish results, approval, NHS access or supply.

registryEvidence.briefTitle: A Study to Learn About the Study Medicine Called Berobenatide (PF-08653944) in People With Overweight or Obesity
registryEvidence.uncertainty: ClinicalTrials.gov reflects the sponsor-submitted study record and can change. Recruitment does not imply broad availability, and estimated completion is not a completed event.

ukPosition.retailSupply: Not established by either source; trial access is research participation, not retail supply.
